cases.situation: Roommate Tyler hasn't paid his half of September's internet and electric, $87. I paid the whole thing on the 5th. We get along fine otherwise.
cases.reply: Hey Tyler, September's internet and electric came out on the 5th, your half is $87. Can you send it over by Friday? I'll start a shared note for the bills so we can both see them from next month.
cases.note: Amount, date and a system, with no commentary. Money goes in writing.

cases.situation: 合租室友的男朋友阿杰最近一周要住四五天，早上洗澡要排队，水电费也涨了。我和室友关系还不错，不想弄僵。
cases.reply: 跟你商量个小事哈。我挺喜欢阿杰的，也理解他常来。不过最近他差不多一周住四五天，早上洗澡要排队，水电也涨了不少。要不我们定一下：一周最多住两晚，或者多住的话他分摊一部分水电？你觉得哪种更合适都行。
cases.note: 说的是房子里的事实，不评价人；带着两个方案去，抱怨就变成了一起做决定。

cases.situation: I asked my roommate about the dishes piling up and she snapped 'I do loads, you just don't notice'. I don't want a fight, I just want a clean kitchen.
cases.reply: Fair, I'm sure I miss some of it. Want to try a rota for October, kitchen on alternate weeks, so we can both see it? If it's annoying we'll ditch it.
cases.note: Don't argue the tally. Agree the goal and let the system do the nagging.

cases.situation: I live in a house with three others. I've just started early shifts at the hospital, my alarm is at 5am, and there's often music and gaming until 1am on weeknights. I want to raise it in our house group chat, not single anyone out.
cases.reply: Hey all, quick house thing: I've started early shifts at the hospital with a 5am alarm, so late noise on weeknights is hitting me harder than it used to. Could we try quiet hours from 11pm to 7am, Sunday to Thursday nights, starting this Sunday? Weekends stay as they are. Happy to tweak it if it clashes with anyone's schedule.
cases.note: Group chat, several housemates: frame it as your schedule change and propose a rule for the house, not a complaint about one person.

cases.situation: 我和两个室友合租，下个月底要搬走了，押金是三个人一起交给房东的。想在群里说一声，顺便把房间交接和最后的水电费说清楚，别到时候扯皮。
cases.reply: 跟大家说个事：我10月31日搬走，这周会正式跟房东说。你们要是想找熟人来住我那间，我很乐意配合带看。走之前想约个时间一起看看房间和客厅厨房的状况，10月30日周五晚上可以吗？卫生间我走前会彻底打扫，10月的水电按账单算好我这份转给你们，押金我们到时候三个人一起跟房东确认。跟你们住得很开心，谢谢你们！
cases.note: 搬走前把日期、交接检查和最后的账单都落在群里，押金三个人一起跟房东对，免得之后各说各话。

cases.situation: My roommate Jess texted that my boyfriend keeps using her oat milk and leaving his shoes in the hallway, and it's 'getting a bit much'. She's right, he's over about four nights a week. I want to reply without getting defensive.
cases.reply: You're right, and thanks for saying it instead of stewing. He's been here a lot more than either of us signed up for. Here's what I'm thinking: three nights a week max, his shoes live in my room, I'll replace your oat milk today, and I'll put an extra $20 a month toward groceries and bills while he's around this much. Happy to change any of that if something else works better for you.
cases.note: When you are the one being complained about: agree first, then bring the concrete fix yourself so she doesn't have to negotiate it.

cases.situation: Comparto piso en Madrid con Irene y Paula. El invierno pasado Irene tenía la calefacción a 25 grados todo el día, incluso sin nadie en casa, y en enero la factura de gas llegó a 186 euros. Ya empieza el frío y quiero proponer algo en el grupo del piso sin señalarla.
cases.reply: ¡Hola, chicas! Antes de que empiece la temporada de calefacción, os propongo algo para que la factura del gas no se dispare como en enero, que llegó a 186 euros. ¿Qué tal si ponemos el termostato a 21 grados cuando estemos en casa y a 17 por la noche o cuando no haya nadie? Si preferís otros números lo ajustamos, y si os parece bien empezamos el jueves 1 de octubre.
cases.note: La factura es un hecho de la casa, no un juicio sobre Irene; llegar con números concretos convierte la queja en una decisión de las tres.

cases.situation: My roommate Kayla owes me $214 for utilities, $102 for August and $112 for September. I reminded her in the house chat on Sept 8 and by text on Sept 20, and both times she said 'yeah will send'. We're both on the lease with Marsh Property. I want to be firm without blowing up the flat.
cases.reply: Hi Kayla, coming back to the utilities: it's $214 in total, $102 for August and $112 for September. I've asked a couple of times now and I need it by Thursday 8 October. If it's still outstanding then, I'll ask Marsh Property about putting the bills into separate accounts, since we're both on the lease. If paying it all at once is tricky right now, tell me and we can do half now and half on the 15th.
cases.note: Past two reminders: exact amounts, a due date and the next step in writing, plus one real way to make paying possible. No comment on her reliability.

cases.situation: My flatmate Leo keeps eating my food from the fridge. Last week it was my leftover lasagne and half a block of cheese, this week my yoghurts. We get on well and it's probably just different habits, but it's adding up.
cases.reply: Hey Leo, small fridge thing. A few bits of my food have gone lately, the lasagne last week and my yoghurts this week, and I'd been planning meals around them. Could we keep to our own shelves and just ask before borrowing something? I'll do the same, and I'm happy to go halves on basics like milk and eggs if that's easier.
cases.note: One issue, told as what happened rather than what he is, plus a small system so neither of you has to police the fridge.

cases.situation: My flatmate Chloe's friend from Australia, Jess, has been sleeping on our living room sofa for 12 nights, and Chloe just mentioned she's staying 'another couple of weeks'. I work from home in the living room. Nobody asked me.
cases.reply: Hey Chloe, can I raise something small about Jess? She's lovely, and it's been 12 nights on the sofa, which is a lot with me working from the living room every day. Could we agree she heads off by Sunday 11 October, and that for anyone staying longer than a week we check with each other first? Happy to talk it through if the dates are tricky.
cases.note: Propose a date and a house rule for next time, not a verdict on the guest.

cases.situation: My roommate Sophie went through a bad breakup last month. Our rota gives her the bathroom this fortnight and it hasn't been cleaned, and the bins are the quickest job on it. I want to be kind and not add to her stress.
cases.reply: Hey Sophie, no pressure at all, I know the last few weeks have been rough. The bathroom's slipped a bit on the rota, which is completely understandable. Want to swap for now: I'll take the bathroom for the next two weeks and you take the bins? Happy to shuffle it however works better for you.
cases.note: When a roommate is struggling, keep the system and lighten their load with a swap, rather than letting it slide or giving a lecture.

cases.situation: 合租室友小周晚上回来经常不反锁大门，这周有两次早上起来发现门只是虚掩着。我们住一楼，我有点担心安全。我们俩平时关系挺好。
cases.reply: 小周，跟你说个小事哈。这周有两次早上起来看到大门是虚掩着的，咱们住一楼，我有点不放心。以后最后一个回家的人负责把门反锁好，行吗？你要是觉得有更方便的办法，也可以说说。
cases.note: 安全的事要早说、说小：讲发生了什么，提一个两个人都遵守的规矩，不评价对方粗心。

cases.situation: My housemate Priya just asked in our flat chat if she can adopt a rescue cat next month. I'm properly allergic to cats, streaming eyes within an hour. I like her and don't want to be the villain, and my lease runs until June.
cases.reply: Hey Priya, I love that you want to rescue one, and I hate being the snag here: I'm properly allergic to cats, streaming eyes within an hour, so a cat living in the flat won't work for me. Would a pet that doesn't shed, like fish or a gecko, be an option for now? Or if it has to be a cat, we could plan it for when my lease ends in June. Happy to talk it through tonight if another idea works better.
cases.note: Saying no to a housemate's plan still comes with a proposal; the allergy is a fact about the house, not a verdict on her idea.

cases.situation: My flatmate Ben just told me he's moving in with his girlfriend at the end of October. We're both on a joint lease with Parkside Lettings until April at £1,400 a month, £700 each, and I can't cover the full rent on my own.
cases.reply: Hey Ben, congrats, that's exciting news. Since we're both on the lease until April, we need a plan for your half. Could we agree you keep paying your £700 until someone takes over your room, and that we find that person together, both happy with them? I'll ask Parkside Lettings this week how a swap works on our lease. Happy to talk it through tonight if you see it differently.
cases.note: Put it in writing early and ask the agent in writing how a replacement is approved. On a joint lease you may be liable for the full rent, so check before you agree to anything.

cases.situation: 合租室友阿凯每天晚上在阳台抽烟，阳台挨着我房间的窗户，烟味都飘进来，我这几天只能关窗睡。我们平时处得还行，他人不坏。
cases.reply: 阿凯，跟你说个小事哈。你晚上在阳台抽烟的时候，烟会从我房间窗户飘进来，这几天我都只能关着窗睡。以后抽烟能不能去楼下抽？你要是有更方便的办法，咱们也可以再商量。
cases.note: 只说烟飘进房间这个事实，不评价他抽烟；带一个具体方案，再留一个调整的余地。

cases.situation: Am Samstag, 3. Oktober, zieht Mia in unsere Dreier-WG ein. Bei uns gibt es einen Putzplan am Kühlschrank, der jede Woche rotiert, und Strom plus Internet kosten zusammen 90 Euro im Monat, die wir durch drei teilen und am Monatsersten an Jonas überweisen. Ich will ihr das vorab freundlich schreiben, bevor es später Missverständnisse gibt.
cases.reply: Hey Mia, wir freuen uns total, dass du am Samstag einziehst! Kurz zwei WG-Sachen, damit du gleich Bescheid weißt: Am Kühlschrank hängt ein Putzplan, der jede Woche rotiert, und Strom plus Internet sind 90 Euro im Monat, also 30 Euro pro Person, die jeweils am Monatsersten an Jonas gehen. Wenn dir nach ein paar Wochen etwas anders besser passt, sag einfach Bescheid, dann passen wir es an.
cases.note: Regeln gleich beim Einzug klären ist leichter, als sie später als Beschwerde einzuführen.

cases.situation: 我和小雨、阿杰三个人合租，只有一个卫生间。早上7点到8点大家都要用，我8点15分要出门赶地铁，这周已经连续三天差点迟到。想在合租群里提一下，大家关系都挺好的。
cases.reply: 早上好呀～这周早上卫生间有点挤，我8点15分要出门，连着三天都差点赶不上地铁。要不我们排一下早上的时段：我7点到7点20，小雨7点20到7点40，阿杰7点40到8点？谁想换时段直接在群里说，我都可以调。
cases.note: 带着具体的时间表去说，讨论就变成了挑时段，而不是谁用得太久。

cases.situation: My housemate Callum has been letting out his room on a short-stay rental site while he travels for work. Three different strangers have stayed this month, and one left the front door unlocked overnight. We're on a joint tenancy with Oakley Lettings, and nobody asked me.
cases.reply: Hey Callum, can I raise something about your room? Three different guests have stayed this month while you've been away, and it's been odd coming home to strangers, especially after the front door was left unlocked overnight. Could we agree no more short-stay guests, and that anyone staying in your room while you're away is someone you know and have told me about first? Happy to talk it through tonight if you see it differently.
cases.note: Keep it about the house. Short lets may not be allowed under your tenancy, so check the agreement before involving the agent, and put what you agree in writing.

cases.situation: My dorm roommate Wei calls his family in Chengdu most nights from 11pm to midnight, which is their morning. I try to sleep by 11 because I have 8am labs, and we share one room. There's a study lounge down the hall that's open 24 hours, and he's really considerate otherwise.
cases.reply: Hey Wei, can I ask about something small? I've got 8am labs, so I'm trying to be asleep by 11, and the evening calls carry quite a lot in our room. I know that's the only time that works with Chengdu, so I'm not asking you to call less. Could you take them in the study lounge down the hall after 11? If another setup works better for you, happy to figure it out.
cases.note: Naming the time-zone constraint shows you're moving the call, not judging it.

cases.situation: 我和小林、阿俊合租三个月了，卫生纸、洗洁精、垃圾袋一直是我顺手买的，三个月大概花了210元。我不想算旧账，只想以后有个办法，打算提议每人每月往群里转20元当公用基金。
cases.reply: 嘿两位，跟大家商量个小事～家里的卫生纸、洗洁精、垃圾袋这些，这三个月都是我顺手买的。以后咱们搞个公用基金吧：每人每月往群里转20块，谁去买谁从里面报，小票拍照发群里就行。之前的就不算了。大家觉得这样行吗？有更好的办法也可以改。
cases.note: 明说“之前的不算了”，对方就不会把提议听成讨债。

cases.situation: Four of us share a house: Megan, Josh, Aled and me. I suggested in the house chat that we get a cleaner every other Friday for the kitchen and bathroom, £60 a visit, so £15 each. Megan and Josh are keen, but Aled replied that he can't stretch to it right now, and I don't want him to feel priced out or singled out.
cases.reply: Totally fair, Aled, thanks for saying so. How about this: the cleaner comes for the three of us who are in, so £20 each, and on cleaner weeks you take the bins and hoover the hall instead. If things change later you can switch to paying in. Happy to tweak it if another setup works better for everyone.
cases.note: When one housemate can't afford a shared cost, offer a way in that isn't money, so nobody is priced out and nobody is carried.

cases.situation: Three of us, Priya, Tom and me, are signing a lease on Monday for a flat at £2,100 a month. Priya's room has the en-suite and is about twice the size of mine, and Tom's is in between. Splitting it £700 each feels off, so I want to suggest £800, £700 and £600 in our group chat before we sign.
cases.reply: Hey both, before we sign on Monday, can we sort out the rent split? The rooms are quite different, and Priya's has the en-suite, so how about splitting by room: £800 for Priya's, £700 for Tom's and £600 for mine, still £2,100 in total. Happy to tweak the numbers if you'd weigh it differently, I'd just like us to agree it in the chat before we sign.
cases.note: Raise a money split before signing, price the rooms rather than the people, and keep the agreed numbers in writing.

cases.situation: I'm Muslim and keep halal. My new flatmate Ollie has started frying bacon in the shared frying pan and cooked pork sausages in the big pot I brought. He's friendly and probably has no idea. I'm going to buy my own frying pan and pot and keep them on the top shelf.
cases.reply: Hey Ollie, a small kitchen thing I should have mentioned when you moved in: I keep halal, so I can't use pans that have had pork in them. Not something you'd have known! I'm getting my own frying pan and pot and keeping them on the top shelf, so could you leave those two for me? Everything else in the cupboard is fair game.
cases.note: State the cultural need as a fact about you, bring the fix yourself, and don't make him feel bad for what already happened.
